extracted.intended_audience: inventors, applicants, patent attorneys, and patent searchers seeking information on Eurasian patent protection and EAPO search tools
extracted.subtask_description: Overview of the Eurasian Patent Organization (EAPO) procedures, scope of protection, and how to search/access Eurasian patent data (Online Register, Gazette, EAPATIS). Useful for deciding filing strategy and performing prior-art/legal-status searches within the EAPO system.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope of protection — single Eurasian patent valid in member states
rubrics_metrics.description: The Eurasian Patent Organization (EAPO) provides a uniform application procedure for physical and legal persons to protect their inventions on the basis of a single Eurasian patent valid in the territory of eight States party to the Eurasian Patent Convention (EAPC): Armenia, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, the Russian Federation, Tajikistan, and Turkmenistan.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This emphasizes that protection is obtained via a single Eurasian patent covering the listed member states (note: Republic of Moldova recognizes validity of Eurasian patents granted on the basis of applications filed with the Eurasian Patent Office before April 26, 2012).

rubrics_metrics.name: EAPO roles under the PCT
rubrics_metrics.description: EAPO may be a receiving office, a designated office, and an elected office under the Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates EAPO can be used at multiple stages of the PCT process (filing/designation/election) for applicants dealing with Eurasian coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Online Register content — issued patents only
rubrics_metrics.description: The online patent register contains information on issued patents only and has a Russian and English interface.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Searchable data are limited to issued Eurasian patents (not pending applications); the interface supports Russian and English and can be accessed without restrictions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Online Register accessible without restrictions
rubrics_metrics.description: It can be accessed without any restrictions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Public access to the Online Register is open — no login or paywall required for the register itself.

rubrics_metrics.name: Available register data fields — Legal Status, Fee Payment, Full Publications
rubrics_metrics.description: Through the patent register you can retrieve information on Legal Status and Fee Payment (for each designated country), and access the Full Publications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users can view legal-status events and fee-payment records per designated country and obtain full publication documents (A1/B1).

rubrics_metrics.name: Searchable identifiers in the register
rubrics_metrics.description: The patent register can also be searched by PCT Application/Publication Number, by Applicant/Inventor Name (in Russian characters) and by Priority Data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicant/Inventor name searches require Russian-character entries; PCT numbers and priority data are supported search keys.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dossier/File Wrapper availability
rubrics_metrics.description: Dossier/File Wrapper Information is not available for general public.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: File wrapper prosecution documents are not publicly accessible through the EAPO register.

rubrics_metrics.name: Online Gazette publication details
rubrics_metrics.description: The online gazette is published monthly in Russian. Its current coverage is from 2007 to present. Every issue is available for viewing in HTML and PDF formats, and can also be retrieved by searching the Eurasian publication server.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gazette issues are downloadable/viewable in HTML/PDF; coverage starts in 2007 for current online issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Retrospective Official Gazette collection
rubrics_metrics.description: Retrospective collection of Official Gazette (1996-2006) is available in PDF format.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Older gazette issues (1996–2006) are available as PDFs via the retrospective collection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supplementary Protection Certificates (SPCs) and patent term extension
rubrics_metrics.description: Protection through Supplementary Protection Certificates (SPCs) is not available, but instruments of Patent Term Extension are possible under the EAPO procedures on extending the term of a Eurasian patent in compliance with the national legislation of each member country.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants cannot obtain SPCs via EAPO; term extension may be achievable, but must follow EAPO procedures and the relevant national laws of each contracting party.

rubrics_metrics.name: Using fee-payment tables to infer country-specific legal status
rubrics_metrics.description: Fee Payment information is available for each designated country in a table; therefore other Legal Status can be inferred for individual contracting parties, e.g. termination due to non-payment of the maintenance fee in Armenia, Azerbaijan, Kyrgyzstan, Kazakhstan, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan and the Republic of Moldova on 17.08.2005, for patent 5202.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Interpreters of register data should use per-country fee-payment tables to deduce country-level events like lapse or termination for non-payment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accessing Full Publications (A1/B1)
rubrics_metrics.description: Full Publications can be obtained, e.g. for patent 5202, for applications (A1) or granted patents (B1) from the Online Register or from the Publication Server.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Both application publications (A1) and granted-patent publications (B1) are retrievable via the register or publication server.

rubrics_metrics.name: EAPATIS English search and resource coverage
rubrics_metrics.description: Search in English is available (for patents only) in the English version of the EAPO patent database EAPATIS. On EAPATIS one can search among a number of internal and external sources.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: EAPATIS provides an English search interface but its free access is limited: free access is limited to EAPO and CIS patents, Espacenet and Patentscope, while paid access is provided to a number of national patents databases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search results link aggregation
rubrics_metrics.description: Search results show the links to the above-mentioned resources (Online Register and Eurasian publication server).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When searching via EAPATIS or the register, results include direct links to the Online Register and publication server for retrieval of documents.
